settings.page_intro: First connect the fixed parts of the energy overview. Then add optional items below the illustration.
settings.native_access_hint: No API key, OAuth or public webpage required.
settings.energy_intro: Select the Homey capability or Logic variable that provides the live value for each component.
settings.solar_count_hint: Only show extra fields when you have more than one source.
settings.battery_count_hint: Choose how many battery systems you want to connect.
settings.charger_count_hint: Only show extra charger fields when needed.
settings.solar1_hint: Current production of the first inverter/installation
settings.solar_extra_hint: Optional. Added to the other PV installations.
settings.battery_capacity_hint: Usable capacity in kWh for the weighted total SOC.
settings.battery_capacity1_hint: Usable capacity in kWh. Required for a weighted total SOC when multiple batteries are used.
settings.battery_power_hint: Added to the combined battery power.
settings.battery_power1_hint: Used for charging/discharging and total battery power.
settings.battery_status1_hint: Optional explicit status. When power is available, HomeFlux uses power as the source of truth.
settings.ev_power_hint: Added to the combined charging power.
settings.home_hint: Optional. Without a direct source, HomeFlux calculates this from solar + grid − battery.
settings.battery_threshold_hint: Standby range around 0 kW for the combined battery power.
settings.grid_threshold_hint: Below this limit the grid flow line stays hidden. Example: 50 W means no line between -50 W and +50 W.
settings.battery_direction_hint: Can be configured separately for each battery.
settings.battery_line_direction1_hint: Determines which state/color is used for the battery flow line.
settings.battery_line_direction_hint: Determines how this battery is interpreted for the combined line.
settings.battery_motion_hint: Optionally reverse only the movement direction of the animated line.
settings.background_intro: Let Homey automatically choose day/night and weather, or use manual settings for testing.
settings.mode_hint: Automatic mode uses sunrise/sunset from the Homey location and, if selected, a weather capability from an installed weather device.
settings.weather_source_hint: Choose a weather/condition/rain capability from an installed weather device, for example KMI. Homey's built-in weather condition is not exposed as a regular device capability and may therefore not appear in this list.
settings.period_hint: Only used in manual mode. Automatic mode uses sunrise and sunset.
settings.weather_scene_hint: Only used in manual mode or as fallback when the weather value is not recognized.
settings.refresh_hint: Periodic synchronization and widget fallback. Realtime updates remain active as well.
settings.weather_mapping: Supported mapping for selected weather devices: clear/sunny → clear, cloudy/overcast → cloudy, rain/showers → rain, mist/fog → mist, snow → snow, thunder/storm → thunderstorm.
settings.extras_intro: These appear as separate cards below the energy overview. If nothing is selected, this section stays hidden in the widget.
settings.selected_extras_hint: Rename items or change their order.
settings.no_devices: No devices found for this search.
settings.type_to_search: Type first to search devices or variables.
settings.no_extra_items: No extra items found for this search.
settings.access_ok: Homey access OK · __devices__ devices · __variables__ Logic variables
settings.capacity_required: Enter the usable capacity in kWh for all connected batteries. This is required to correctly calculate the weighted total SOC.
settings.saved: Dashboard saved. Live updates are active.
settings.widget_text_size_hint: Fixed text size for the energy cards, independent of the system font size.
settings.widget_title_size_hint: Adjust only the names at the top of the energy cards, such as Solar and Battery.
settings.label_custom_hint: Leave empty to use the default translated name.
